item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 11/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring fine and very hot weather to southern China in the next couple of days. The broad trough of low pressure over the central part of the South China Sea to the vicinity of the Philippines is expected to move northwards in the latter part of this week, and bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea. The anticyclone aloft will cover the coast of Guangdong again early next week.
